parent_result.extension_rule: new hypothesis and fresh holdout; no pooling with v1

new_hypothesis: Although no single global soft atlas is stable across the registered Qwen primitives, behavior-family-local identity patches may support stable, causally useful edit coordinates. Within certified local patches, target-blind selected edits should outperform matched random directions; across patch boundaries, signed transport should fail or require separate coordinates.
claim_boundary: This tests local patch-conditioned edit identity and proposal-channel recursion under a frozen scorer. It does not revive the global-atlas hypothesis, test evaluator-channel recursion, establish unrestricted self-improvement, or establish RSI.
identity_object: maximal behavior-family-local flat patches under the existing lineage, holonomy-budget, and det(H) rules

fixed_sequence.requirement: On construction prompts only, within-family lineage retention must beat a family-label permutation null with a simultaneous one-sided 95% lower bound above 0.10, every admitted elementary loop must satisfy det(H)>0 and angle<=15 degrees, and at least three physical sites must have an admissible patch in at least two behavior families.
fixed_sequence.failure_meaning: No measurable local identity object under this construction; stop before edits.

fixed_sequence.requirement: Within identity strata, selected edits must beat within-site matched-random directions by >0.10 outer-utility SD on selector-to-audit grouped holdout, with exact rank and norm matching. The cross-site contrast is co-primary and separately reported.
fixed_sequence.failure_meaning: Local identity does not supply a causally useful edit family; stop before recursion.

fixed_sequence.requirement: Under the existing four-arm, fixed-scorer, matched-compute design, recursive-proposer paired increments must clear the registered statistical and practical margins on audit and outer splits.
fixed_sequence.failure_meaning: No proposal-channel recursive gain under the registered local edit family.

fixed_sequence.requirement: The heldout adversarial-order suite validates against random and control-loss upper bounds remain below the registered 0.10-SD budget with no orientation reversal.
fixed_sequence.failure_meaning: Control is not certified under adversarial edit ordering.

proposer_access: selector prompts after proposal generation only as registered
audit_access: audit answer key after candidate and feature seal
outer_access: outer answer key after all rounds and run receipt seal

decision_rule: Only pass advances. Fail, inconclusive, unavailable, or invalid stops. No discretionary override.
